text: Meet your Gemi. It exists because you met it.
A small you, living on your campus.
Your day has limits. So does its day. It has to choose what matters.
Ask in any language. It brings back three things.
Every detail is checked against its source, or not shown.
On pages we didn't pick: 3.2 percent wrong, against 8.4 for one AI call.
It guesses before you choose, and shows when it was wrong.
Underneath: a base Gemini designed, a gate on every field, and a Managed Agent that goes back to the source, live.
Go somewhere real, and a keepsake arrives. It opens new rooms and meets other Gemis.
